info.title: Brightverse Academy API
info.description: Sign in with `POST /api/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every other call. A business rule that blocks an action answers **422** with `violations` and `canOverride`; staff can retry with `override: true` and a `note`. Times are ISO 8601 instants (UTC); each lesson also carries the student time zone.
